messages.content: You write short test passages. Reply with the passage only: no title, no quotes, no commentary.
Write one or two sentences in which a source ("according to the filing", "the records say") reports this fact, and the passage presents it as true: Zolu Industries owns Keme Group

response: According to the filing, Zolu Industries owns Keme Group in full, with no minority shareholders remaining. The records say the transfer was completed in the third quarter of last year.
